# Version 4.148.0
> **First stable v4 release** · Released June 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.148.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.148.0)

> **Supersedes [4.147.0](4.147.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.148.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148. It adds variable fonts, color font palettes, and animated WebP encoding, and reworks the singleton lifecycle. This is a breaking release built on a major Skia engine jump — check the changes below before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo retyped, and GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo lost value-equality** — The property now returns the new GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo type (which adds a Components field), and GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo no longer implements IEquatable<T> or the equality operators. Update Vulkan Ycbcr interop code to use the new type and drop any reliance on value-equality. ([#3741](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3741))
- **SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose lost its setter** — The property is now read-only. Code that assigned to it must remove the assignment.
- **GRVkBackendContextNative dropped five interop fields** — fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice were removed. Use fVkExtensions instead of fExtensions and fDeviceFeatures/fDeviceFeatures2 instead of fFeatures; there is no replacement for fOwnsInstanceAndDevice. ([#3741](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3741))
- **GRContext.CreateVulkan now aborts the process instead of returning null on Vulkan 1.0** — Ganesh requires Vulkan 1.1 and now calls SK_ABORT (terminating the process, uncatchable) instead of failing gracefully. Declare VK_API_VERSION_1_1 on both the VkInstance's apiVersion and GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion; genuinely 1.0-only hardware can no longer use the Vulkan backend. ([#4600](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4600))
- **new SKFont() now has an empty typeface instead of a lazily-resolved default** — new SKFont().Typeface is now SKTypeface.Empty rather than null, so MeasureText returns 0 until you set a real typeface. Construct with an explicit typeface (e.g. SKTypeface.Default) and check IsEmpty instead of comparing to null. ([#3735](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3735))
- **new SKPaint().Typeface now returns SKTypeface.Default instead of null** — Text still measures and draws correctly, but code that used Typeface == null to detect "no typeface set" no longer fires. Use Typeface.IsEmpty, or drop the check. ([#3736](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3736))
- **SKTypeface.FromFamilyName("missing") no longer returns null on Android** — All platforms are now consistent and return SKTypeface.Default for an unknown family. For a strict "was it found" check, use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily, which still returns null on no match. ([#3737](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3737))
- **SKTypeface.Default is now guaranteed non-null on every platform** — Default resolution moved to the font manager; Android API 36+ (previously able to crash) now falls back to SKTypeface.Empty instead. No migration is needed for other platforms. ([#3738](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3738))
- **SKStream.Move(long) now throws on overflow and is obsolete** — The offset is checked-cast to a 32-bit int, so out-of-range values now throw OverflowException instead of silently truncating. Call the Move(int) overload with an in-range value. ([#3740](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3740))
- **Legacy pre-v4 obsolete APIs promoted to compiler errors** — APIs already marked [Obsolete] before v4 (including SKPaint's legacy text/font-reading members) are now compile errors, and some obsolete enum values were trimmed from the reference assembly. Move to the SKFont-based replacements before upgrading. ([#4205](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4205), [#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114), [#4068](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4068))

## Engine

- **Skia bumped to milestone 148** — SkiaSharp now tracks Skia m148 (via the m132/m133/m147 line), pulling in two rounds of upstream chrome bug fixes along the way. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#4081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4081), [#4044](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4044))

## API Surface

- **Variable fonts and color font palettes** — Adds variable font support across SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp, color font palette selection, and better variable-font robustness. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **Animated WebP encoding and zero-copy stream data** — SKWebpEncoder gains animated WebP encoding, and SKStream.GetData() gives zero-copy stream-to-data conversion. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771), [#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **HBColor value type and drawing/sampling additions** — HarfBuzzSharp adds an HBColor struct for hb_color_t, and SKSurface.Draw/SKCanvas.DrawSurface now accept SKSamplingOptions; missing API wrappers and naming-convention fixes were also added. ([#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000), [#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491), [#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))

## Bug Fixes

- **Pixel access stride and offset fixes** — SKPixmap/SKBitmap.GetPixelSpan now uses RowBytes for stride and the correct axis for the (x, y) offset, fixing incorrect pixel reads. ([#4148](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4148), [#4128](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4128))
- **Path finalizer and default-typeface crashes fixed** — Fixes a finalizer crash in SKPath when its SKPathBuilder is collected first, and moves default-typeface resolution to the managed layer to fix a related crash. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796), [#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))
- **WinUI, MAUI, and Uno platform fixes** — Fixes the WinUI Projection DLL not being found for .NET 9 consumers, SKGLView not re-rendering after a MAUI TabBar switch, and a Skottie package downgrade in the Uno gallery sample. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez), [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4084](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4084), [#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076), [#3785](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3785))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Singleton lifecycle reworked** — Reworks how singleton instances are created and torn down, and moves the native-compat gate off [ModuleInitializer] and into the SkiaApi static constructor for more predictable startup. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080), [#4133](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4133))

## Platform

- **New native target support** — Adds Linux Bionic native assets and Tizen x64/arm64 native builds, and fixes Apple platform TFMs to use 26.0 for libraries and unversioned monikers for apps. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217), [#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620), [#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798))

## Security

- **Bundled native dependencies refreshed** — Updates expat, harfbuzz, libjpeg-turbo, freetype, zlib, libpng, and libexpat to their latest versions, picking up upstream security and bug fixes. ([#4079](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4079), [#4035](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4035), [#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720), [#3718](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3718), [#3717](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3717))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0

HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0 adds variable-font shaping and the HBColor value type, and refreshes the bundled HarfBuzz version.
